mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a scholar that makes this case and looks at the relation between the demographic factors and it impact on democracy itself."
Edward Wambala is a scholar that makes this case and looks at the relation between the demographic factors and it impact on democracy itself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the processes, the actions, the behaviours through which this potential power is utilized and realized" (Pfeiffer, 1990)."
Politics and influence are the processes, the actions, the behaviours through which this potential power is utilized and realized" (Pfeiffer, 1990).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the formal and informal processes by which decisions are made concerning the use, production and distribution of resources in any given society."
Political systems are the formal and informal processes by which decisions are made concerning the use, production and distribution of resources in any given society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the African scholars who believe that there is a connection between democracy and development but that Africa gets it wrong."
Claude Ake is one of the African scholars who believe that there is a connection between democracy and development but that Africa gets it wrong.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded, within Bentham's utilitarian thought, as an 'evil' because it causes pain."
Punishment is regarded, within Bentham's utilitarian thought, as an 'evil' because it causes pain.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of government that allows the citizens to be involved and participates in the decision making."
Democracy is a form of government that allows the citizens to be involved and participates in the decision making.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best mode of punishment because it serves as effective deterrent and also useful preventive measures."
The protective philosophy is the best mode of punishment because it serves as effective deterrent and also useful preventive measures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to show that patterned principles of just distribution are incompatible with liberty."
Nozick's famous Wilt Chamberlain argument is an attempt to show that patterned principles of just distribution are incompatible with liberty.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of related manuscripts that were assembled and published in English only shortly before Bentham's death."
The Rationale of Punishment is a collection of related manuscripts that were assembled and published in English only shortly before Bentham's death.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key to public policy."
Reconciling competing 'pleasures' is the key to public policy.
